subject.title: [Feature Request] Session List: Show timestamp + last message preview

question: Should this feature land as a narrow Control UI Sessions-list enhancement now, be replaced by a maintainer-sponsored branch, or be folded into the broader sessions workspace direction?
rationale: The backend contract exists and the UI gap is clear, but a linked external PR is conflicting/proof-needed and the issue carries maintainer/product-decision labels, so automation should not open a parallel fix without direction.

options.title: Repair the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 and ask for a conflict-free branch that uses `lastMessagePreview` plus real Control UI proof.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow replacement
options.body: Close or supersede the stale linked branch only after a maintainer-backed replacement implements the same focused UI behavior with tests and proof.

options.title: Fold into sessions workspace
options.body: Defer this narrow display request into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/80901 if maintainers want one larger session-overview design instead of incremental row previews.

recommendation.title: Repair the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue paired with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/48396 and ask for a conflict-free branch that uses `lastMessagePreview` plus real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He committed the existing preview contract and has recent adjacent session-routing history, making him the best available owner for product/API direction.
